purpose: Mark regular spacing between repeated events.
keywords: Quantity of time / distance + おきに.
This bus comes every ten minutes.
There is a sign every hundred meters along the road.
I take a short break every thirty minutes.
formation: Quantity of time / distance + おきに.
restrictions: Day-based expressions can be interpreted differently in casual use; clarify dates when precision matters.
mistake: Distinguish a gap between events from a count of events.
